name: qc-landing-roof-pair
notes: Batch roof: TWO swap pistons armed by ONE machine, then ONE release removes both bedrocks. Targets [0,3,0] and [2,3,0]; A0 [0,2,0] and A2 [2,2,0] face down. The carrier redstone block [1,3,0] sits BETWEEN the two quasi cells (the bedrocks) and powers both by quasi-connectivity; the updater stone lands at [1,2,0], BETWEEN the two pistons, so one landing arms both. SP [1,3,2] (sticky, north, power block behind at [1,3,3]) carries the carrier; U [1,2,-2] (sticky, south, power block at [1,2,-3]) pushes the stone from [1,2,-1]; U sits on the far side so SP's power never quasi-powers it. Same 8-tick beat as qc-landing-roof-clock. The chord swaps A0 (one key press); the script swaps A2 one cycle later (the player's second press); the release pulls the carrier and lands one block between them: both headless pistons retract unpowered and both bedrocks go in the same tick.
